name: Taizhou
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local registration/land-record evidence was found, but no anonymous public parcel polygon was verified for this locator. No full geometry or owner/address data is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Taizhou bureau responsibility documents identify the city Real Estate Registration Service Center and its cadastral-investigation, registration, database, and issuance duties.
technicalBlocker: The official city data/map portal was not reachable or did not expose a parcel feature endpoint through the available public review; no safe point-specific geometry query was available.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the official TianDiTu Taizhou or spatial-data platform exposes parcel polygons to anonymous clients, and whether that service covers the WUP point.
nextStep: Obtain an accessible official map-service endpoint or metadata from the city bureau, then test a bounded anonymous geometry-only query at the WUP point.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Official Taizhou bureau documents and municipal spatial-data portal were reviewed. Portal access did not reveal a public cadastral feature service, and the Zhejiang public-map host returned HTTP 420 during the read-only request. A superficially similar Jiangsu Taizhou (泰州) portal was excluded because the ranked point is Taizhou, Zhejiang (台州). No geometry request was made.
